decisive_items: anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody of 237.39 units (normal <20 units)
synovitis of the bilateral distal radioulnar joints and the left second metacarpophalangeal joint
response.rationale: R3 is supported by specific serologic markers (RF and anti-CCP) and MRI synovitis, consistent with RA despite normal ESR/CRP. R5 relies only on ANA positivity without specific antibodies, while R1 is contradicted by negative dsDNA/ENA, R2 is contradicted by seropositivity, and R4 is temporally inconsistent as symptoms predate COVID.

rejected.why: Patient is seropositive (RF and anti-CCP positive), so seronegative RA is incorrect.
SLE requires specific antibodies; negative ENA and dsDNA, and joint pattern is more RA-like.
Symptoms began 4 months prior, while COVID occurred 1 month before presentation, so not a post-COVID trigger.
